title: Battery module on its liquid cold plate
pickerTitle: Battery module on its liquid cold plate
line: Conjugate heat transfer through battery module M01, its gap filler, an aluminum cold plate and the laminar coolant in its serpentine, against a 45 C cell limit.
description: The eight prismatic cells of module M01 (20 W each) on 3 mm gap-filler pads and a brazed aluminum cold plate with a four-pass 14 x 4 mm serpentine. The coolant is its own body in the RunMat MCAD part, sharing its channel walls with the plate. The study solves the laminar coolant flow (Re 1130 at 2 L/min of 50/50 water-glycol from 25 C) and the heat through every solid together, and reports the peak cell temperature against 45 C, the coolant's temperature rise and the pressure drop.
thumbnailAlt: Eight prismatic battery cells on gap-filler pads over an aluminum liquid cold plate, modeled in RunMat
